scope.goal: Establish the repository security-workflow baseline without changing application behavior.

security_invariants.rule: Default to read-only work; obtain explicit human approval before any repository, cloud, deployment, or secret-access mutation.
The Reviewer must be independent of the Coder for every implementation review.
Record Planner-to-Coder, Coder-to-Reviewer, and Reviewer-to-Planner contracts for every implementation task.
Do not make a security claim without traceable code, configuration, test, review, or approved-risk evidence.

authorization_expectations: Human approval is required before code or configuration changes.
The user alone runs FireFlow locally after an approved release gate.
No agent may read, print, or commit credentials, tokens, private keys, .env values, or Secret Manager values.

positive: Verify that the three declared workflow files exist on the pilot branch.
Verify that a future Planner-to-Coder handoff validates against the framework schema.
negative: Verify that the workflow does not authorize deploy, FireFlow, push, merge, cloud changes, or secret access without explicit human approval.
Verify that a self-review is rejected for non-L1 implementation work.

prohibited_actions: No application-code, Firebase Rules, Cloud Function, dependency, or deployment modification in this pilot.
No FireFlow execution, Firebase deployment, tag, merge, or production release.
No secret retrieval, disclosure, or repository commit.
